photos.desc: The Barbary Partridge breeds on the Rock of Gibraltar and nowhere else on mainland Europe
I'm afraid this is a very poor photo. A pair of these birds ran across the track while walking down to the beach over a scrub covered sand dune near Jandia, Fuerteventura
